lead.t: Patients with this syndrome typically carry a point mutation within the WT1 gene.\nThe Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome is characterized by hemihypertrophy, macroglossia, and visceromegaly, with a risk of developing Wilms tumor of 3-5%.

src.t: Devendra K. Gupta, Krishna M. Goel - Hutchison’s Paediatrics. chdhe-Jaypee Brothers (2012)
